name: stem-calc-student-mcp
description: STEM calculator MCP for chemistry and physics homework: molar mass, balancing equations, grams to moles, unit conversion, significant figures and empirical formulas. Works offline, no account or API key.

tools.name: molar_mass
tools.description: Parse a chemical formula and return the molar mass in g/mol with the mass each element adds. Handles brackets and hydrates like CuSO4.5H2O.

parameters.name: formula
parameters.description: Chemical formula like H2O, Ca(OH)2 or CuSO4.5H2O. Write each element with a capital first letter.

tools.name: balance_equation
tools.description: Balance a chemical equation written with -> and +.

parameters.name: equation
parameters.description: Equation like H2 + O2 -> H2O

tools.name: stoichiometry
tools.description: Convert between grams, moles and particles. The formula is required whenever grams are the from or to unit. Converting between moles and particles needs no formula.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The amount to convert.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: What the value is in.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: What to convert it to.

parameters.name: formula
parameters.description: The chemical formula, like H2O. Required when from or to is grams. Not used otherwise.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between units of length, mass, time, volume, energy, temperature, pressure, speed or flow rate. Common spellings like ml, degC, °C and L/min are accepted. It refuses to convert one kind of unit into another.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number to convert.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The unit it is in, like km, kg, mL, J or C.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The unit to convert it to.

tools.name: round_sig_figs
tools.description: Round a number to a given number of significant figures.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number to round.

parameters.name: sigFigs
parameters.description: How many significant figures to keep.

tools.name: empirical_formula
tools.description: Find the simplest whole number formula from mass composition. Pass each element's mass or its percent of the total.

parameters.name: composition
parameters.description: Each element's mass or its percent of the total, like {C: 40.0, H: 6.7, O: 53.3}.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Whether the numbers are percentages or masses. Defaults to percent.

tools.name: percent_composition
tools.description: Find the percent by mass of each element in a chemical formula, along with the molar mass. This is the reverse of empirical_formula.

parameters.name: formula
parameters.description: Chemical formula like H2O, Ca(OH)2 or CuSO4.5H2O. Write each element with a capital first letter.

tools.name: solution_math
tools.description: Solve molarity (M = mol/L) or a dilution (M1V1 = M2V2). Leave out the one value you want and it is solved. Volumes are in liters.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: molarity solves M = mol/L. dilution solves M1V1 = M2V2.

parameters.name: moles
parameters.description: Moles of solute. Molarity mode only.

parameters.name: liters
parameters.description: Volume of the solution in liters. Molarity mode only.

parameters.name: molarity
parameters.description: Concentration in mol/L. Molarity mode only.

parameters.name: initialMolarity
parameters.description: Starting concentration M1 in mol/L. Dilution mode only.

parameters.name: initialLiters
parameters.description: Starting volume V1 in liters. Dilution mode only.

parameters.name: finalMolarity
parameters.description: Final concentration M2 in mol/L. Dilution mode only.

parameters.name: finalLiters
parameters.description: Final volume V2 in liters. Dilution mode only.

tools.name: limiting_reagent
tools.description: Find the limiting reagent and theoretical yield for a reaction. Pass the unbalanced or balanced equation and the grams of every reactant. It balances the equation first, then reports the limiting reagent, the theoretical yield of a product in grams and moles, and the grams left over of each excess reactant.

parameters.name: equation
parameters.description: The reaction, like N2 + H2 -> NH3.

parameters.name: reactants
parameters.description: The grams available of every reactant. Each item has a formula, written as in the equation, and grams.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The product to report the yield for, written as in the equation. Defaults to the first product.
